title: Three boundary-circle quotient of the coefficient-space quantum pair-of-pants algebra for 0<a<1, positive r1,r2, a+r2<1 and r1+r2<a
author: Slawomir Klimek; Matt McBride; Sumedha Rathnayake; Kaoru Sakai
difficulty_reason: The proof first constructs all compact matrix units from the finite-rank commutator and isolates the three infinite boundary-channel projections by spectral calculus. Explicit half-line recurrence resolvents supply the necessary spectral separation, after which the author builds and proves bijectivity of a three-component Toeplitz symbol map.
source_version: Official SIGMA 11 (2015) article 012, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2015.012; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Complete Theorem3.15 and its essential Theorem3.10 compact-ideal construction, Theorem3.11/Lemma3.12 recurrence analysis, Theorem3.13 and Proposition3.14 read. The Hilbert norm is the sum of squared coefficients in the E_n=zeta^n,F_n=(zeta/r1)^n,G_n=((zeta-a)/r2)^n basis, rather than an unspecified Bergman space. All six-channel defining actions and the explicit resolvent operators are present; the author omits only repeated Schur-Young geometric-series bounds after exhibiting the operators and a representative estimate. Standard Toeplitz symbol compactness facts are explicitly recalled in Section2.1. No disk/annulus, multiplication spectrum or individual zz-star eigenvalue result is counted separately.

statement_scope: Full Theorem3.15 for real 0<a<1, r1,r2>0, a+r2<1 and r1+r2<a, with the precise coefficient Hilbert space of Section3.1 and multiplication z. Its compact ideal K lies in C-star(z) by Theorem3.10 and C-star(z)/K is C(S1) direct-summed three times, via the explicit boundary-channel Toeplitz map. No generic Hardy/Bergman-space substitution.
editorial_warning: Theorem3.11 prints the eigenspace at eigenvalue1 as span E_n for n>=0, whereas the displayed system(3.4) treats E0 separately. Proposition3.14 explicitly adds the already constructed PE0 to the isolated spectral projection to obtain PE. The selected quotient theorem follows that explicit projection construction; no independent eigenbasis statement is selected and original author bytes are unchanged.
source_boundary_note: The complete original C*-algebra quotient Theorem 3.15 and every required author compact-ideal/spectral-channel proof are retained for the exact coefficient Hilbert space on the pair of pants. Full basis actions, finite-rank commutator, all compact matrix-unit constructions, explicit half-line recurrence/resolvent analysis, three boundary projections and bijective three-component Toeplitz symbol map are supplied. The source norm is the sum of squared E/F/G coefficients; no generic Bergman/Hardy substitution is made. Repeated Schur–Young geometric-series bounds are the bounded routine estimates the author explicitly leaves after giving each operator and a representative bound. Standard Toeplitz symbol facts are recalled as background. No disk/annulus, multiplication-spectrum or individual eigenvalue statement is separately counted.
